newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - May 21.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - May 21.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Wednesday:
* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones industrial average ended with a gain of 74.58 points, or 1.03 percent, at 7,303.46 as investors cheered the Federal Reserve's decision to hold interest rates steady.

* Tens of thousands of supporters of the Moslem-oriented United Development Party (PPP) campaigned across the main Java island on Tuesday and there was considerable violence in Jakarta and in the Central Java town of Pekalongan.
* On Tuesday, the Jakarta composite index rose 0.28 points to close at 652.83 points.
* On Wednesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,442.75/44.00 at 0145 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,442.00/44.00.
* Small property firm Mas Murni on market talk of a possible take-over.
* Glass and ceramics maker Mulia Industrindo after announcement of lower first quarter net profit.
* Ciputra Development after reports that subsidiary PT Ciputra Surya planned to issue six-year 300 billion rupiah straight bonds.
* Chemical firm Unggul Indah on a proposed acquisition of Salim Oleochemicals Pte Ltd.
* Salt producer Fiskaragung and retailer Matahari on announcements of higher first quarter results.
* Kasogi on reports of a proposed rights issue and a possibility of a link-up with a Brazilian footwear firm.
